lesson: The system is failing to distinguish between genuine trend reversals and liquidity sweeps, resulting in entries during high-volatility distribution phases. Relying on low-confidence setups (21-25%) in a choppy market has led to consistent stop-outs as the price fails to sustain momentum.
adjustment: Implement a minimum confidence threshold of 65% and filter all entries against the 4-hour RSI to avoid trading into overextended momentum.
methodology_flag: Trust Wyckoff distribution patterns less on lower timeframes until a clear structural break is confirmed on the 4H chart.
